title: The Dragon Remembers
style: extreme narrative rap with dark soul/trap, punchy hip-hop drums, melodic manifesto chorus and controlled cinematic tension

narrative.central_conflict: father murdered by an anonymous killer; family structure and financial stability destroyed
narrative.resolution: The Dragon refuses to surrender his future to revenge and turns the fury into truth, remembrance, family protection and legacy

chorus.hook: You took my father — now the whole world knows.
chorus.moral_line: I don’t need your blood, I need the truth in the light.
chorus.resolution: You can’t kill a legacy — I’m bringing it to life.

performance.vocal: deep chest voice, clenched consonants, pressured breath, restrained growl, harsh attack, explosive chorus projection
performance.verses: cold narrative pocket with internal rhymes and short double-time bursts
performance.bridge: half-time confession at the edge of revenge
performance.final_state: furious but inspiring; justice through memory and legacy

mix_direction.vocal_processing: fast compression attack, harmonic saturation, subtle parallel distortion, short room reverb
